description.ja: 「サザビー」へとつながる「機動戦士MOON ガンダム」主役機がHGで立体化！
description.en: The main character of "Mobile Suit MOON Gundam " that leads to " Sazabi" is now three-dimensional in HG!

description.ja: • サザビーに通じる肩形状をはじめ、全身ディテール再現に加え、腕、脚の各所は高い可動域が実現されている！
description.en: • In addition to the detailed reproduction of the whole body, including the shoulder shape similar to Sazabi, various parts of the arms and legs have a high range of motion!

description.ja: • 「サイコプレート」はバックパックのアームを展開して懸架可能なほか、分離、組み替え機構を搭載！
description.en: • "Psycho Plate" can be suspended by expanding the arm of the backpack, and also has a separation and recombination mechanism!

description.ja: • ビーム・トマホーク、ビーム・ライフル、展開ギミックを再現したバタフライ・エッジが付属し、各ビームパーツはクリアパーツで表現！
description.en: • Beam tomahawk, beam rifle, and butterfly edge that reproduces the deployment gimmick are included, and each beam part is expressed with clear parts!
